key_idea: Combine Euler-formula discharging, which forces one of an unavoidable set of configurations, with Kempe-chain reducibility of each configuration in a minimal counterexample.
reason: The conceptual skeleton (minimal counterexample, discharging from Euler's formula, Kempe-chain reducibility) is clear and classical. However, the actual work rests on computer verification of 633 configurations and a 13,000-line case analysis with rules partly chosen by trial and error, so no human can survey why the theorem holds.
recognized: Robertson–Sanders–Seymour–Thomas proof of the Four Colour Theorem (1997)
